title: Bootlegger Speakeasy | 11 Beds | Rooftop Spa Sauna
description:
Step into Bootlegger’s Speakeasy—a one-of-a-kind luxury stay just minutes from downtown Nashville.

This 4-level townhome blends a moody, upscale speakeasy vibe with high-end amenities, designed specifically for large groups, bachelorette/bachelor trips, and unforgettable weekends.

From the private rooftop with hot tub + sauna to your own hidden speakeasy lounge with poker table, every space is built for connection, entertainment, elevated comfort, and a truly unique Nashville experience.

The space
🍸 THE EXPERIENCE

This isn’t just a place to stay—it’s your private venue.

🎲 Private Speakeasy Lounge

* Poker table + lounge seating
* Full bar setup
* Vinyl record player
* Hidden photo booth
* Leather seating + moody lighting

🌇 Rooftop Oasis (4th Level)

* Hot tub under the stars
* Sauna for relaxation + recovery
* Outdoor TV + lounge seating
* Grill + large dining table
* Perfect for sunset drinks and late-night hangs

🛏️ SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (11 BEDS | 4 BEDROOMS)

Designed for large groups without sacrificing comfort:

• Bedroom 1: King bed + private bathroom
• Bedroom 2: Two double beds + private bathroom
• Bedroom 3: Four double beds + private bathroom
• Bedroom 4: Four double beds + private bathroom

✔ 11 total beds
✔ Each bedroom has its own ensuite bathroom
✔ Ideal for groups getting ready at the same time

🏡 MAIN LIVING SPACE

* Designer living room with luxury speakeasy aesthetic
* Fully equipped modern kitchen
* Bar seating + open layout
* Custom mural: “Bootlegger’s Speakeasy”
* Perfect for group meals, drinks, and socializing

📍 LOCATION

Located in the Horizon development:

~10 minutes to Downtown Nashville / Broadway
Quick Uber/Lyft to bars, restaurants, and music venues
Close enough for convenience, far enough for privacy

🔥 WHY GROUPS BOOK THIS HOME

✔ Unique speakeasy concept
✔ Rooftop hot tub + sauna combo 
✔ Built specifically for large group stays
✔ Multiple hangout zones 
✔ High-end, Social media worthy moments

👯 PERFECT FOR

* Bachelorette & bachelor parties
* Birthday trips
* Nashville weekend getaways
* Friends & group travel
* Celebrations

🔥 If you’re looking for a high-end, one-of-a-kind Nashville stay designed for groups, Bootlegger’s Speakeasy delivers an experience you won’t find anywhere else.

Book now to secure your dates—weekends fill quickly.
